blocks.text: Architectural facade design for a barbershop, Kyiv, Ukraine

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) developed an architectural solution for the renovation of a barbershop facade in Kyiv, Ukraine. The task was to bring together contemporary design, the shop’s brand identity, and the character of the surrounding buildings.
The architectural concept combines modern finishing materials, carefully selected color solutions, decorative elements, and exterior lighting.
The key focal points are the entrance area, the proportions of the facade, and the details that make the barbershop stand out from the street.
The facade gained a recognizable look in keeping with a premium men’s space.
For a commercial property, the facade is an important part of the brand’s visual presentation and the customer’s first impression.

items: a visual connection with the barbershop’s brand identity;
a functional, clearly marked entrance area;
integration of the property into the surrounding urban environment.

parts.html: Photorealistic 3D visualizations show the finishing materials, colors, details, decorative lighting, and entrance area of the renovated facade in its street setting.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN — architectural design, commercial facade design, renovation solutions, and photorealistic 3D visualization.
